title: Lobby Instantiation and Self-Organization
need: Organize your instantiated vocabulary neighbors so they can be located from known information and meaningful relationships among neighbors can be represented.
constraints: Do not assume a supplied semantic organization.
Do not silently create facts about a vocabulary neighbor.
Keep identity distinct from occurrence, location, and activation.
Preserve reversible Matrix/Index reachability for every admitted neighbor.
Use separately typed indexes for relationships that are not the same kind.
Propose organization before it is admitted as validated structure.
Record failed proposals and revisions rather than overwriting them.
